 About Miguel Sesma Espinosa
 CountrySpain
 Recorded matches75
 Available seasons2023/2024 – 2026/2027
 Competitions3
 Miguel Sesma Espinosa, born on January 31, 1995 in Logroño, La Rioja, is a Spanish referee who currently officiates matches in the Spanish Second Division. Throughout his career, he has refereed a total of 105 matches, showing 487 yellow cards and 11 red cards, averaging 4.64 yellow cards per game. On October 5, 2024, during the match between Racing de Santander and Real Zaragoza at La Romareda, Sesma Espinosa validated a goal for Racing that generated controversy. The VAR suggested canceling the goal due to a possible infringement in the goal kick, but after reviewing the play, he decided to uphold his initial decision, which sparked criticism from the Zaragoza team.
